# TextCard

Text-only news / content card. Headline, optional body copy, and inline read-more CTA. No media. Use in 3-up news grids on light surfaces.

## Decisions

- ⏳ **open** `tc-archetype` `low confidence` (scaffold): Scaffolded as card (named "TextCard — v2"). Confirm, or re-run npm run specs:scaffold -- --slug=text-card --archetype=<link-card|card|collection>. _Evidence: decided by heuristic; token namespaces content×2; state axis none_
  - The draft chose: card — named "TextCard — v2"
  - Alternatives: link-card: A card that is one link: illustration or icon, a headline, optional description, an arrow affordance. The whole surface is the target and the headline is the accessible name.; collection: A row, grid or scroller of one repeated unit.; button: Triggers an action. A label, optional leading and trailing icons, and the full interactive state set.; checkbox / radio: A selection control with a checked state, usually paired with a label.; toggle / switch: A binary on/off control that applies immediately.; input / field: Accepts typed input. Label, value, placeholder, and an error state.; badge / tag / chip: A small label. Non-interactive unless it is dismissible.; pagination: Moves between pages of content.; accordion: A disclosure: a trigger that shows and hides a region of content. Open or closed is a prop a consumer sets, not an interaction state.; select / dropdown: A choice among options. The native <select> does the choosing; the design styles the trigger around it.; helper text: Guidance or a message under a field: hint, error, success. Associated with its field, never floating.; list: A sequence of like items — features, links, steps. The items are the content; the list is the rhythm.
  - If wrong: npm run specs:scaffold -- --slug=text-card --archetype=<link-card|card|collection> --force
